public_rationale: The OpenAI analysis shows a plausible cost-recovery problem in one case. Reporting on Midjourney points against the universal wording. Neither supplies the matching financial evidence needed to settle the claim under a consistent definition of sustainability. A universal conclusion cannot be inferred from losses at selected labs.
limitations: The proposed sustainability test is an interpretation of broad wording.
The strongest accessible apparent exception is secondary reporting with an unspecified profit measure.
The claim's unknown accounting basis prevents a supported or contradicted financial verdict.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Every AI startup is economically broken at its foundation.

statement.excerpt: The very foundation of every AI startup is economically broken.
statement.document_title: The Subprime AI Crisis Is Here

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that every AI startup has a business model unable to cover its ongoing costs sustainably from customer revenue.
Temporary losses caused by expansion do not by themselves establish that a business model is fundamentally unsustainable.
Use calendar 2025, the latest complete annual financial period before the post, because the claim specifies no reporting period.
The surrounding discussion concerns generative-AI services. Whether the wording also encompasses other AI startups remains ambiguous.
criteria.support_condition: Comprehensive evidence establishes structurally unsustainable economics across the relevant startup population, including credible apparent exceptions.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one qualifying startup demonstrably sustains its service and necessary ongoing development from customer revenue on a disclosed, comparable cost basis.

evidence.explanation: This estimate lends weight to concerns about recovering model-development costs. It concerns one model at one company and cannot establish that every startup has an unsustainable foundation.

evidence.locator: Section Competitive Pressures and Legal Battles
evidence.explanation: Reported profitability makes Midjourney a material apparent exception to the universal claim. This secondary account does not provide target-period accounts or specify what costs its profitability measure includes.
